sources.entry: Navicat Data Modeler - Cost-effective database design tool for high-quality data models.

summary.name: Navicat Data Modeler
summary.one_liner: Navicat Data Modeler is a visual database design tool for building entity-relationship diagrams, reverse-engineering live databases, and generating SQL.
use_cases: Design new database tables visually on a canvas
Reverse-engineer an ER diagram from a live database
Generate target SQL for a schema
Import DDL or .sql files to build a diagram
Maintain a shared business glossary for data definitions
Optimize existing table structures and indexes
summary.what_it_does: The tool provides a hybrid canvas for logical entities and physical objects such as tables, views, and functions, with conversion from conceptual to logical to physical models and mapping to keep them in sync. It supports Relational, Dimensional, and Data Vault 2.0 methodologies, with Crow's Foot, IDEF1X, and UML notations. It connects to live databases through a native driver or ODBC and generates an ER diagram from the schema structure only, without pulling data. It can also paste DDL or import .sql files, and includes AI features to build tables from simple instructions, suggest indexes and fields, and detect and fix errors in code.
notable: Hybrid canvas linking logical and physical models with model mapping and conversion
Supports Relational, Dimensional, and Data Vault 2.0 methodologies
AI-assisted table building, optimization, and error fixing
Reverse-engineers live schemas without pulling any data
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Supported Linux distributions are listed by specific version, so other versions are not named
